tldr: North Node in House 7: growth through partnership, reciprocity, contracts, clients, and being met by others.
body: This nodal axis asks the person to develop partnership, reciprocity, contracts, clients, and being met by others. The South Node in House 1 shows the familiar life field: over-identification with independence, image, or doing everything alone. The house axis describes where the growth has to become lived, not just understood. The practice is to let relationship become a place of conscious choice.
business: Growth becomes practical when the person chooses partnership, reciprocity, contracts, clients, and being met by others in the concrete house topics of daily life.
shadow: Under stress, the South Node in House 1 can pull the person back toward over-identification with independence, image, or doing everything alone.
policy: Read as a nodal axis: North Node house names the growth field; South Node house names the familiar field. Requires accurate birth time for house placement.
note: Distilled from approved project node source material. Source files were not copied into the repository.
